question: How does Nexus Mutual pool risk (capital pool, NXM pricing, staking, claims assessment, governance), what is its scale on 2026-10-08, and where do the other on-chain insurance protocols stand?

frame.population: on-chain discretionary mutuals and cover protocols
frame.exposure: contract source, chain reads, docs, DeFiLlama

item.title: NexusMutual/smart-contracts: Pool, Ramm, Cover, Assessments, Claims, Governor, Registry

findings.finding: Modules: capital (Pool, Ramm, SafeTracker, SwapOperator), cover (Cover, CoverNFT, CoverProducts, LimitOrders), staking (StakingPool beacon proxies per pool, StakingNFT, StakingProducts), assessment (Assessments, Claims), token (NXMToken, TokenController), governance (NXMaster, Governor, Registry, VotePower).
findings.exactSourceLanguage: contracts/modules: assessment capital cover governance legacy staking token

findings.finding: NXM price comes from the RAMM, a ratcheting AMM with two virtual pools: constants LIQ_SPEED_PERIOD 1 day, RATCHET_PERIOD 1 day, TARGET_LIQUIDITY 5,000 ether, FAST_LIQUIDITY_SPEED 1,500 ether, NORMAL_RATCHET_SPEED 400 and FAST_RATCHET_SPEED 5,000 over RATCHET_DENOMINATOR 10,000, with per-direction circuit-breaker limits (ethLimit, nxmLimit); it exposes getBookValue, getSpotPrices and a three-period TWAP. The price therefore tracks capital pool book value, with the ratchet moving the price toward book each day.

Repo head (commit 2026-04-16) contains a new Governor: TIMELOCK_PERIOD 1 day, VOTING_PERIOD 3 days, ADVISORY_BOARD_THRESHOLD 3, MEMBER_VOTE_QUORUM_PERCENTAGE 15 (of token supply), PROPOSAL_THRESHOLD 100 ether, VOTE_WEIGHT_CAP_PERCENTAGE 5; vote weight is token balance plus 1 ether for any member, capped at 5 percent of supply, and voting locks the voter's tokens until the deadline.

Assessments are run by assessor groups held by member id (addAssessorsToGroup, removeAssessorFromGroup, setAssessingGroupIdForProductTypes are callable only by the Governor), with startAssessment, castVote and closeVotingEarly; Claims has submitClaim, redeemClaimPayout (members only, pausable) and retrieveDeposit.
README points to Immunefi for the bug bounty and to the docs for audits; deployments are listed through the SDK at sdk.nexusmutual.io.

item.title: Nexus Mutual on Ethereum: NXMaster lookups and capital reads (block 26149894)

findings.finding: cast against eth.drpc.org at block 26149894 (unix 1791489191): NXMaster 0x01BFd82675DBCc7762C84019cA518e701C0cD07e getLatestAddress returned Pool (P1) 0xcafea91714e55756C125B509274eDE9Bc91697CB, TokenController (TC) 0x5407381b6c251cFd498ccD4A1d877739CB7960B8, MemberRoles (MR) 0x055CC48f7968FD8640EF140610dd4038e1b03926, Cover (CO) 0xcafeac0fF5dA0A2777d915531bfA6B29d282Ee62, Assessment (AS) 0xcafea55aE10FB1bf21F7aF7a285488C42B59a24A, Ramm (RA) 0xcafea54f03E1Cc036653444e581A10a43B2487CD, Governance (GV) 0xcafea6063d4Ec6b045d9676e58897C1f0882Ca32, CoverProducts (CP) 0xcafead81a2c2508e7344155eB0DA67a3a487AA8d; the Claims slot (CL) returned the zero address.

Pool.getPoolValueInEth() = 43,328.22 ETH; Pool.getMCR() = 5,998.72 ETH (so the pool holds about 7.22 times the minimum capital requirement); Ramm.getBookValue() = 0.026148745 ETH per NXM; Ramm.getSpotPrices() = 0.026489 and 0.025676 ETH; NXM totalSupply() = 1,656,990.47 NXM (token 0xd7c49CEE7E9188cCa6AD8FF264C1DA2e69D4Cf3B); Pool native ETH balance 3,576.37 ETH, the rest held in other assets.
Structure: the DAO "operates as a discretionary mutual" and the Foundation "is a community interest company (CIC)"; members pool capital, buy cover and underwrite risk by staking NXM.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: The Foundation is a community interest company (CIC)

findings.finding: Claims now: a three-person Claims Committee (Hugh Karp, Roxana Danila, BraveNewDeFi); each assessor casts one vote with a rationale; "Any claim that is submitted opens a 72-hour voting window"; 2 of 3 accept votes approves; claimants post a 0.05 ETH deposit; after voting a 24-hour cool-down in which the Advisory Board can reverse fraudulent votes and replace assessors; accepted claims can be withdrawn for 30 days.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Any claim that is submitted opens a 72-hour voting window.

findings.finding: Retired versions: V1 (2019 to March 2023) any member could stake NXM to assess, 70 percent consensus threshold, 36-hour window, 10 percent of cover price locked as a cover note; V2 (March 2023 to November 2025) stake-weighted majority decided claims and an ETH deposit replaced cover notes.
